simulation_assumptions.note: Only these robot hardware, sensor and geometric assumptions are not specified by this PDF.
simulation_assumptions.manual_judging: Illegal target and zone commands prevented; subjective human penalties and real hardware failures are not randomly simulated.
simulation_assumptions.map_fidelity: Chapter 4 dimensioned module footprints and figure4-5 placement; unlabelled joints reconstructed from the plan, not official CAD.
simulation_assumptions.armor_model: finite rectangular robot/base/outpost armor planes with separate solid body and opening-cover occlusion; approximate structure geometry is public

rune_motor.note: Both small and large runes use smoothly varying shaft speed throughout the match; both faces share the same motor. This overrides the manual's constant small-rune speed.

structure_geometry.note: Finite proxies reconstructed from manual figures 4-10/11/32; unlabelled armor centers and motion are simulation assumptions, not official CAD.

pickup_phases.note: Requires actual arm contact, closing, lift and storage. Keep pick_unit true; leaving, destruction, weakness or manual arm control cancels.

simulation_assumptions.physics_engine: rapier3d-f64 0.26.1 enhanced-determinism; 120Hz rigid bodies and ray suspension
simulation_assumptions.robot_hardware: 19 selectable symmetric hardware designs; default six-model lineup preserved; construction bounds enforced
simulation_assumptions.hardware_authority: robot_designs is authoritative; family specs speed/acceleration are retained only for old SDK compatibility

ground_camera_fov_deg.note: Ground FPV follows the physical muzzle direction and chassis pose. Own robot state and referee telemetry remain unrestricted; aerial vision keeps its existing coverage.
